title: Qualify integrated JBMC on the distinct single-cell array grid
description: Build each actual array method with a scalar entry whose low bits represent all four distinct, non-null one-cell heaps. Check the injective complete-root observer on the JVM, then establish the preserving pair and replay the skipped-write witness for the distinguishing pair with JBMC.

steps.name: Four concrete heaps, two actual JBMC comparisons
